text:
The MGAP National Forest Cartography (version 2021), from Uruguay's Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries, is the source that classifies the loss area by forest type. It maps about 13.1 ha of the 13.5 ha event area as native forest. About 0.4 ha falls outside mapped forest, and none is planted forest.

The other sources don't make that distinction. Hansen GFC measures the loss (13.5 ha, 3.91% of the asset). JRC GFC2020 only confirms forest was present in 2020 (98% agreement) and includes plantations.

Caveats: the MGAP map gives territorial context, not cause. The loss is still pending corroboration because 2025 is the latest year observed. The evidence doesn't establish deforestation, cause, legality, or responsibility.
